notes: Thirty-seven environmental review documents, one per project, for the address-titled projects of 1995-2011 - the batch that follows the 1983-1991 downtown and South of Market reports and finishes the address-titled set. The draft was read where a project has a draft and a final, and the revised draft where one supersedes the draft. The richest documents are those that append a consultant's historic resource evaluation or a Section 106 review: 275 10th Street carries a Carey & Co. survey of twenty-nine properties with a dated summary for each, and 178 Townsend Street carries a building history that walks the California Electric Light Company's Station B from 1888 to 1995 permit by permit. Where a project site is a surface parking lot - 631 Folsom, 888 Howard, 55 Ninth, 201 Folsom, 300 Spear, 450 Rhode Island - the report has nothing to say about a building and yields nothing.
